name: 123FormBuilder
description: 123FormBuilder is an online form and survey platform for collecting registrations, applications, feedback, payments, files, and other structured submissions.
agentUseSummary: 123FormBuilder cannot be newly connected under Relay's provider-owned delegated authorization model. Its current API v2 issues tokens only after receiving a customer username or email plus password or MD5 passhash in URL query parameters, then requires the JWT in query parameters on data reads. Relay mounts no account password, passhash, token, or form-submission tools.

blocked.label: Connect 123FormBuilder

blocked.label: Use account credentials
blocked.description: Relay does not collect a customer's primary username/email and password or MD5 passhash to mint an API token.

blocked.label: Use the API
blocked.description: Forms, fields, submissions, groups, users, accounts, webhooks, and every read or mutation remain unavailable because no supported connection is mounted.

providerSetup.blocker: 123FormBuilder API v2 has no documented delegated OAuth or current API-key flow. Its official Swagger contract accepts username/email plus plaintext password or MD5 passhash as query parameters to POST /token and requires the resulting JWT as a query parameter on form and submission reads.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep 123FormBuilder unavailable unless the provider publishes a safer delegated OAuth or purpose-built API credential contract, or a separate security review explicitly authorizes the customer-account-password exchange and URL-bearer transport model.

evidence.supports: 123FormBuilder documents API v2's US and EU account endpoints and token-based API model.
The current authentication reference exposes login, refresh, invalidate, form, submission, group, user, and account operations but no delegated OAuth or API-key flow.
The provider-hosted Swagger 2.0 contract requires username or email plus plaintext password or MD5 passhash in query parameters for token issuance and requires JWT query parameters on data reads.
123FormBuilder marks the older API-key API as deprecated and directs integrations to API v2.
